name: ccc-mission-board
description: Interactive touchscreen missionary board for CCC, fed by Gathered

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.dev:mock: MOCK_GATHERED=1 VIEWER_ALLOWED_NETWORKS=127.0.0.1,::1 DATA_DIR=./data-mock npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
